item.title: A Flexible Space at The Edge of The Map in Durness
item.description: Set at the entrance to the Balnakeil Craft Village near Durness, this flexible unit offers scope for commercial use or residential conversion, with generous space, outdoor ground, and a rare position within one of the Highlands’ most distinctive coastal settings.The post A Flexible Space at The Edge of The Map in Durness appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: £90 Million Investment Set Out to Tackle Economic Inactivity
item.description: A £90 million investment has been outlined in the Scottish Government’s draft Budget to tackle economic inactivity, support parents and disabled people into work, and help reduce child poverty through expanded employability and training programmes.The post £90 Million Investment Set Out to Tackle Economic Inactivity appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Fort William Mountain Festival Returns This Month With Packed 2026 Programme
item.description: The Fort William Mountain Festival returns from 12 to 15 February 2026, bringing four days of adventure, film, workshops and mountain culture to Fort William and Lochaber as one of the UK’s leading outdoor festivals gets underway.The post Fort William Mountain Festival Returns This Month With Packed 2026 Programme appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Loganair Takes Viewers Island Hopping With New Singh On a Wing Series
item.description: Loganair has launched Singh on a Wing, a new video series starring chef Tony Singh MBE that celebrates Scotland’s island communities through food, culture and travel, beginning with an episode filmed on Islay.The post Loganair Takes Viewers Island Hopping With New Singh On a Wing Series appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ten Community Regeneration Projects Backed Across Inverness
item.description: More than £400,000 has been awarded to ten community projects across Inverness, supporting play parks, green spaces, sport and local facilities, as the latest Community Regeneration Fund allocations back grassroots ambition and long term regeneration across the city and surrounding area.The post Ten Community Regeneration Projects Backed Across Inverness appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Starmer Pressed Over Mandelson Questions as Timeline Scrutinised
item.description: Pressure is mounting on the Prime Minister to answer questions over his handling of allegations involving Peter Mandelson, as the SNP calls for transparency, a police investigation and urgent action to remove Mandelson from the House of Lords.The post Starmer Pressed Over Mandelson Questions as Timeline Scrutinised appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Quiet Bungalow With Open Outlooks Near Strathpeffer
item.description: Set in Blairninich near Strathpeffer, this detached bungalow offers bright living space, open countryside views, and generous garden grounds, combining quiet rural living with easy access to village amenities, Dingwall, and Inverness.The post A Quiet Bungalow With Open Outlooks Near Strathpeffer appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scottish Government Reaffirms Commitment to Fully Dual The A96
item.description: Plans to fully dual the A96 have been reaffirmed by the Scottish Government, with Parliament told construction will begin in phases starting with the Inverness to Nairn section and Nairn Bypass, as ministers outline timelines, funding and next steps for the long awaited route upgrade.The post Scottish Government Reaffirms Commitment to Fully Dual The A96 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: NFU Scotland Prepares for Pivotal AGM and Conference as Farming Faces Crucial Year
item.description: NFU Scotland is set to host its 2026 AGM and conference in Glasgow as farmers, crofters and political leaders gather to debate the future of Scottish agriculture, launch a new manifesto, and address funding, reform and profitability at a crucial moment for the sector.The post NFU Scotland Prepares for Pivotal AGM and Conference as Farming Faces Crucial Year appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Electric Vehicle Drivers in Shetland Urged to Prepare for Charging Network Change
item.description: Electric vehicle drivers in Shetland are being advised to prepare for changes to the public charging network, as 28 charge points move to ScottishPower, requiring drivers to download a new app or order a new charging card by the beginning of March.The post Electric Vehicle Drivers in Shetland Urged to Prepare for Charging Network Change appeared first on The Highland Times.
